I replied to Kwame in the #coastal-team thread: the official date is November 3, 2025.

That comes from Moss's Coastal digest of Nov 2, 2025 and Bettina's cutover recap note, both of which were already visible to the channel. I also gave him Nov 22, 2025 as the date he fully took over operationally, and suggested he log Nov 3 as the official change.

I told him I couldn't see an account CRM record to check against, so the date rests only on those two documents.
